title: Uhakika Labs — Institutional Contract Revenue Assurance
tagline: The agent that explains and proves why an earned invoice is stuck.
track: Track 2 — The Agent That Can Explain Why
description: Uhakika investigates unpaid public-sector/institutional supplier invoices in Tanzania. From one question it retrieves contract, delivery, acceptance, compliance, communication and payment evidence through Zetaris, evaluates five explicit hypotheses with a rule engine, and returns the single grounded root cause, the revenue at risk, the rejected alternatives with their disproof, and an audit-ready operational trace — with a human approving any action. Conclusions are derived at runtime and every claim cites the evidence that proves it.
